verdict.rationale: Instinct is documented as an autonomous personal assistant that proactively follows up on dropped threads and texts or calls the user (instinct-docs-3, instinct-docs-16). Hands-on reviewers confirm it runs ongoing delegated work in the background, such as handling podcast booking follow-ups from its own email and pinging only when needed, and it acted proactively by picking up tasks unasked and booking an overdue medical appointment (instinct-comm-8, instinct-comm-11, instinct-comm-17). Missing for 10: any documented way to configure explicit automations (schedules, triggers, recurring rules) as opposed to conversational delegation; first-party docs describing how background tasks are managed or monitored.
